usage: Import via src/lib/catalog.ts getPaywallCopy(locale). Agent 4/5: surface on locked cards, module player gate, and pricing CTAs.

tones.principle: Soft paywall — never block browsing titles; never shame; always leave a free path (demos + trial).

lockedBody.en: You can preview the library and play free demos anytime. Start a 7-day Pro trial to open the full STEM library for your family.
lockedBody.zh-HK: 你可以隨時瀏覽課程庫同玩免費示範。開始 7 日 Pro 試用，全家解鎖完整 STEM 課程庫。

lockedBodyShort.en: Free demos stay open. Subscribe or start a trial to play this one.
lockedBodyShort.zh-HK: 免費示範照玩。訂閱或開始試用就可以玩呢個。

ctaTrial.zh-HK: 開始 7 日 Pro 試用

wrongTierTitle.zh-HK: 你嘅計劃係另一個課程庫

wrongTierBody.en: Basic includes either Primary or Secondary. Upgrade to Pro for both — or keep enjoying your current library plus free demos.
wrongTierBody.zh-HK: 基本計劃包括小學或中學其中一庫。升級專業版可兩者兼得——或者繼續用而家個庫同免費示範。

trialBanner.en: Pro trial ends in {days} day(s). Subscribe to keep full access.
trialBanner.zh-HK: Pro 試用尚餘 {days} 日。訂閱即可保留完整權限。

trialExpired.en: Your trial has ended. Free demos are still yours — subscribe to unlock the library again.
trialExpired.zh-HK: 試用已結束。免費示範仍然屬於你——訂閱即可再次解鎖課程庫。

pricingFreeBlurb.en: 15 forever demos · no card required to try
pricingFreeBlurb.zh-HK: 15 個永久示範 · 試玩唔使信用卡

pricingBasicBlurb.en: Choose Primary or Secondary library for your child’s stage
pricingBasicBlurb.zh-HK: 按子女階段揀小學或中學課程庫

pricingProBlurb.en: Full Primary + Secondary STEM library for the whole family
pricingProBlurb.zh-HK: 全家完整小學＋中學 STEM 課程庫

libraryGateGuest.en: Playing as guest — free demos only. Sign in for trial or subscription access.
libraryGateGuest.zh-HK: 訪客模式 — 只可以玩免費示範。登入後先有試用或訂閱權限。
